headline: MediaTek VP Ching San Wu describes continuing collaboration on Synopsys Agentic AI AMS Platform
fact: In a Synopsys announcement, MediaTek vice president Ching San Wu describes continuing collaboration on the Agentic AI AMS Platform for creating, optimizing and implementing analog/mixed-signal designs. He distinguishes this work from an earlier deployment of SmartFloorplanning. The release schedules broader AgentEngineer and Autopilot availability for the end of 2026. This records a named customer-side statement about collaboration, not completed deployment of the announced AMS platform or measured company-wide design productivity.

sources.title: Synopsys: long-horizon agents and Autopilot Platform
sources.summary: September 28, 2026 release quotes MediaTek VP Ching San Wu on continued Agentic AI AMS Platform collaboration; the same release says portfolio availability is planned for the end of 2026.
